category_title: Students with learning difficulties and speech needs who engage through collaborative play and leadership roles
scenario_title: Transitioning from creative project back to standard work
minimal_context: The student is instructed to begin standard English lesson work following the conclusion of a creative drama project.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Now that our final performances are finished, please open your books so we can begin our standard English lesson work.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sighs loudly) Wait, the scheme is completely over?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Yes, it is. Please look at the first question on the board.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Moans) Can't we just do more acting instead?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to focus on this reading assignment right now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't want to do this. Acting is fun, work is boring.

TUTOR: Now that our final performances are finished, please open your books so we can begin our standard English lesson work.

TUTOR: We need to focus on this reading assignment right now.

STUDENT: I don't want to do this. Acting is fun, work is boring.

task.content: Standard English lesson work following a creative project

context.time_context: End of the project reflection following the final performance

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When they realised the scheme was over and had to return to standard work
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Began sighing and moaning, asked for 'more acting', and were prone to disengagement
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Feeling that work is boring compared to acting
related_quotes: acting is fun, work is boring

behavior_patterns.condition: When student absences disrupt collaborative group work
